card.name: Right after a drug name, before dose
card.fires_on: The spot just after a drug name where an amount is about to follow, such as an opening parenthesis, comma, space or 'in' after the name. It also fires inside the drug name itself, as in diaz-epam.

modes.label: Parenthesis or space after drug
modes.description: The punctuation right after a drug name, just before the dose figure.
modes.example: Narcotic premedication frequently used during clinical trials included fentanyl<< (>>1.5 to 2 mcg

modes.label: Linking word after drug
modes.description: A small word such as 'in' after a drug and comma, leading into increments or amounts.

modes.label: End of drug name
modes.description: The last piece of a drug name where a dose is expected next.
modes.example: should be initiated with an intravenous benzodiazepine, e.g., diaz<<epam>>, in increments of 0.1

card.writes: It promotes words for 'each', 'doses' and 'ranging', which sets up a per-dose amount.
card.plain: It fires when a drug has just been named and the amount to give is about to be stated.
